reviews.text:
The doctors and nurses are all very kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care. The clinic is also very clean and well-maintained. They explain things in a way that's easy to understand, even for someone with no prior knowledge, allowing me to fully grasp my pet's condition.🥲✨
Even though it's my first pet and my first time at a vet, they are incredibly patient and helpful, never making fun of me.
I'm even considering moving, but I wouldn't want this clinic to be so far away...
Thank you so much for everything. I look forward to continuing to rely on you in the future.🙏✨

I have been a patient here for over two years.

The veterinarian and nurses are all very kind.

They treat patients with genuine care, always considering the perspective of both the animal and the owner.

They are incredibly knowledgeable and observant, and they offer multiple treatment options, categorizing each case.

Since visiting this clinic, I have truly come to appreciate the invaluable time I spend with my pet.

I am deeply grateful.

The very kind veterinarian at the animal hospital where I had been taking my pet for over 10 years closed due to health reasons, and I came here instead.

Choosing a veterinary clinic is always a source of anxiety, but I am truly grateful for the care I received here.
The doctor was friendly and the hospital had a warm atmosphere. It was our first time at a veterinary hospital, but neither the humans nor the cats felt nervous.

Our elderly rabbit repeatedly suffered from intestinal obstruction due to hairballs, and we were deeply grateful for your care each time.

The doctor always took her advanced age into consideration and treated her carefully, minimizing any burden on her.

Unfortunately, due to her physical limitations, she was unable to recover and passed away peacefully the other day.

Being able to be by her side as a family at the end, and saying goodbye while crying so much, was a great comfort to us.

We are not yet considering getting another pet, but if we ever have the opportunity to need your services again, we would be very grateful.

We are truly grateful to the doctor and all the staff for their kind and attentive care. Thank you so much.

On one occasion, I was about five minutes late for my taxi ride due to traffic. I apologized immediately upon arrival and explained the situation, but I was repeatedly told in a harsh tone, "If you're going to be late, you should call beforehand," which felt quite condescending. Of course, I acknowledge my own fault for being late, but the lack of consideration in their tone was upsetting.

On another occasion, even though I arrived on time for my appointment and was shown to the examination room first, someone who arrived later was served first at the payment counter. The owner of the later-arrived pet was surprised, saying, "What? I was late, but I'm being served first?" The receptionist simply explained, "Your appointment was earlier," which left me confused about the criteria.

Furthermore, when I left my dog ​​for half a day of hospitalization, it seemed their diaper hadn't been changed even once, and it was returned in a messy state, soiled with feces and urine. I felt quite uneasy about the hygiene and care provided.

Another receptionist was very kind and pleasant, even opening the stroller door for me, making the contrast with some of the staff's service all the more disappointing.


The other receptionist was very kind and pleasant, which made the difference in service between her and some of the other staff members all the more disappointing. While I have a positive impression of the doctor and the hospital itself, I am concerned about the reception staff's attitude and the level of care provided, and I am worried about continuing to visit the hospital in the future.

I visited this clinic for my kitten's first health checkup.

Both the doctor and the nurses were very polite and the doctor's explanation of the examination was easy to understand.

I had made an appointment in advance, so there was no waiting time.
They treat pets as family. I'm always grateful for how they cherish them as important members of their family.

My first thought was, why didn't I come here earlier? This is the first time I've seen a dog wagging its tail as it enters an examination room. I wonder if the doctor understands dog language. It can get busy at times, but I try to come here by being creative with my schedule and taking advantage of the reservation system. By the way, they also accept patients without an appointment, which I think is another great thing about them.
They always examine our dog kindly and carefully. Our dog seems to think they're going out to play...

I've been seeing this clinic for about a year and a half since he was a puppy. He hasn't had any serious illnesses, but he has been treated for allergies and other conditions.
They explain treatment options in a logical and easy-to-understand manner, so I trust them.
My dog ​​loves the doctors and nurses, and when we pass the clinic on a walk, he clings to the door, wagging his tail and refusing to let go.
We also use the pet hotel.

I'm lucky to have a good clinic so close to home.

The doctors and all the staff are very kind! They always answer my questions thoroughly.

My usual hospital was closed, so I went to this hospital for the first time.

We welcomed our six-month-old cat into our care and have been using their services since he was neutered.
They also take care of our cat when we visit home. …
